links.outcome: ChatGPT response quality (correct, concise, comprehensive, comprehensible) by prompt health literacy level
links.effect: Prompts written at higher health literacy levels generally yielded higher-quality answers, implying lower-quality responses for lower-literacy prompts. Some responses were hazardously incorrect and incomplete.
links.quote: Prompts formulated at higher levels of health literacy generally yielded higher-quality answers.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT responses to 123 prompts across cardiovascular health topics evaluated by experts across user literacy levels and languages.
